config.kalioupo_equipment.title: Kalioupo's Equipment
tooltip.kalioupo_equipment.bedrock_shard: Chisel bedrock with a diamond pickaxe or better, thirty hits
Only used in a smithing table to upgrade obsidian gear
tooltip.kalioupo_equipment.compressed_ob: Smelted from obsidian, carbon steel, copper alloy and a diamond
Upgrades diamond gear to obsidian in a smithing table
jei.kalioupo_equipment.bedrock_shard.1: Right click bedrock while holding a diamond pickaxe or better.
jei.kalioupo_equipment.bedrock_shard.2: Thirty hits yield one shard. The bedrock block is never removed and fortune does not apply. Shards only work in a smithing table: they upgrade obsidian gear into bedrock gear, two per piece.
jei.kalioupo_equipment.compressed_obsidi: Smelt one obsidian, two carbon steel ingots, one copper alloy ingot and one diamond. Obsidian is only a small part, the bulk is steel and copper.
Combined with obsidian it upgrades diamond gear in a smithing table.
tooltip.kalioupo_equipment.echo_core.1: 25% warden drop, the core of the starlight alloy
tooltip.kalioupo_equipment.echo_core.2: Rarer than a blaze rod, commoner than a wither skull
jei.kalioupo_equipment.echo_core.1: A Warden drops one with a 25% chance. The echo set no longer uses it.
jei.kalioupo_equipment.echo_core.2: Smelt it with a nether star: one star + one core + 2 netherite + 2 amethyst + 2 diamonds gives 4 starlight ingots, a whole set of armour.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.better_t: Smelt your first carbon steel ingot. Better than iron, by a little.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.stronger: Craft any alloy ingot for the first time.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.quartz_u: Craft quartz steel. Fragile, but it really bites.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.copper_t: Craft copper alloy and your plating gets sturdier.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.rose_gol: Craft rose gold. Pretty, and absurdly enchantable.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.speciali: Craft prismarine alloy and breathing underwater stops being a problem.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.magic_po: Forge the amethyst sword, charge it, then press V for lightning.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.aerodyna: Smelt a phantom ingot, the start of gliding.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.obsidian: Forge any piece of obsidian gear.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.bedrock_: Chisel bedrock thirty times with a diamond pickaxe.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.warden_s: Smelt an echo alloy ingot, the ancient city's reward.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.road_to_: Forge any piece of bedrock reinforced gear.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.peak.des: Forge any piece of echo reinforced gear.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.king_of_: Forge any piece of starlight gear. You reached the end.
message.kalioupo_equipment.socket_status: Sockets %s/%s, charge +%s%%/%s%%: weapons take ingots or a sword, armour takes a same-slot piece or an ingot (shift to swap)
message.kalioupo_equipment.socket_help: Hold our gear in the main hand and an ingot (weapons) or armour piece (armour) in the off hand, then right click
trait.kalioupo_equipment.rose_gold.ingot: repairs 1 point / 5s (works from anywhere in the inventory)
trait.kalioupo_equipment.rose_gold.armor: repairs 2 points / 5s (works from anywhere in the inventory)
message.kalioupo_equipment.socket_nested: A socketed item cannot be used as material
message.kalioupo_equipment.socket_no_tra: That material has no socket trait
message.kalioupo_equipment.socket_capped: The charge bonus is already at its cap (%s/%s)
message.kalioupo_equipment.socket_armor_: An armour socket takes one armour piece of the same slot, the rest take ingots
message.kalioupo_equipment.socket_kind: Wrong kind: weapons take ingots or a sword, armour takes a same-slot armour piece or an ingot
trait.kalioupo_equipment.prismarine.ingo: water breathing and no water drag
trait.kalioupo_equipment.prismarine.armo: water breathing and no water drag
trait.kalioupo_equipment.phantom.ingot: fall damage -50% (-10% per extra socket, cap -80%)
trait.kalioupo_equipment.phantom.armor: fall damage -50% (-10% per extra socket, cap -80%)
trait.kalioupo_equipment.quartz.ingot: attack damage +2 (max +6), 1 extra durability per hit
trait.kalioupo_equipment.quartz.armor: attack damage +2 (max +6), 1 extra durability per hit
jei.kalioupo_equipment.socket_table.1: Sockets: drop another piece of our gear or a material into a socket, only its trait carries over.
jei.kalioupo_equipment.socket_table.2: Weapons and tools take ingots; armour takes one same-slot armour piece, the rest take ingots.
jei.kalioupo_equipment.socket_table.3: Right click with gear in the main hand and material in the off hand, shift to swap, empty off hand to remove. The charge bonus is a player total, capped at +80%.
advancements.kalioupo_equipment.first_so: Put the first socket into a piece of gear at the socket table.
trait.kalioupo_equipment.skill.amethyst: socketed sword: Thunder (charge bar + charge on hit)
message.kalioupo_equipment.socket_ejecte: Sockets ejected: %s is about to break
message.kalioupo_equipment.socket_cannot: A socket only keeps the item and its wear: enchanted or renamed gear cannot go in
